video_title: Bucks Reporter on latest Giannis to Celtics RUMORS | Celtics Daily

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Haslam set an artificial deadline for the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: Jimmy Haslam put an artificial deadline in the draft, June 23rd, in public, May 8th.
quotes.quote: The Bucks owner, Jimmy Haslam, put an artificial deadline in the draft, June 23rd, in public, May 8th. And so, but it is artificial. It is not a real deadline. There is a deadline to trade Giannis, it is February, because he is under contract. But Jimmy said, hey, if we are going to do this, we, meaning the Bucks, need to make a decision to trade him or continue to build around him. And he said ideally by the draft.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks are seeking multiple assets in a potential Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: The underlying tone, the underlying message everyone took from that was an additional first-round pick in 2026.
quotes.quote: The underlying tone, the underlying message everyone took from that was an additional first-round pick in 2026. Which is why you are kind of seeing a lot of Bucks trying to get two picks or three, whatever it may be. It is all rooted in those statements back in early May.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: John Horst does not leak information from the Bucks front office
quotes.excerpt: John Horst does not leak. He has a very small front office and he does not discuss anything.
quotes.quote: John Horst does not leak. He has a very small front office and he does not discuss anything. Quite famously, and this might not be known to Celtics fans, the Damian Lillard trade, he literally created a bunker in the Bucks locker room in the off-season. There were people on his immediate staff that did not know what he was doing.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: John Horst has a history of blindsiding his own staff with trades
quotes.excerpt: This was the acquisition of Jrue Holiday back in 2020. This was the acquisition of Damian Lillard.
quotes.quote: This was the acquisition of Jrue Holiday back in 2020. This was the acquisition of Damian Lillard in 2023, and it was the wave and stretch of Damian Lillard and the signing of Miles Turner in 2025. I mean, think about free agency rumors and leaks. He is a free agent. No one knew the Milwaukee Bucks were in that mix.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's willingness to extend would come from his camp
quotes.excerpt: That would obviously have to come from his camp because only he would know if he is going.
quotes.quote: That would obviously have to come from his camp because only he would know if he is going to extend and Sam Amick and Eric Nehm are very good. So, I would believe that if they wrote it.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo is generally complimentary of other cities and coaches
quotes.excerpt: Giannis is generally complimentary of other cities or other coaches.
quotes.quote: Giannis is generally complimentary of other cities or other coaches. I am not saying it does not make it special, what I am saying is Giannis is a very smart guy. He would never burn bridges that had yet to be built.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading Giannis would be a total pivot for the Bucks franchise
quotes.excerpt: If you are the Milwaukee Bucks and you are trading Giannis, the point is to pivot the franchise.
quotes.quote: If you are the Milwaukee Bucks and you are trading Giannis, the point is to pivot the franchise. And you are moving in an entirely new direction and keeping Jaylen Brown, one year younger, next season is his age 30 season, one million dollars less, that works.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's market value is similar to Giannis Antetokounmpo's
quotes.excerpt: I would imagine as an all-NBA wing who has won a title, he is also in the same boat.
quotes.quote: I would imagine as an all-NBA wing who has won a title, he is also in the same boat as Giannis in that I would think teams that are ready to try to win or win more in the next one to four years want Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo is a better player than Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Giannis is a better player than Jaylen Brown, but Giannis is also not for everyone.
quotes.quote: Giannis is a better player than Jaylen Brown, but Giannis is also not for everyone. Jaylen checks a box for almost every contending team or team that wants to contend.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks have done a good job of not signaling their intentions
quotes.excerpt: The Bucks have just done a really good job of not signaling anything.
quotes.quote: The Bucks have just done a really good job of not signaling anything other than we are trading Giannis or we are going to extend him. That is the only thing that they have said and directionally pointed something to. And obviously even then, those are two paths that could look wildly different.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard trade package was not enough to get him
quotes.excerpt: A lot of these guys were not enough to get Damian Lillard a couple of years ago.
quotes.quote: A lot of these guys were not enough to get Damian Lillard a couple of years ago. And so, Giannis is better than Damian.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks need to address rim protection and spacing
quotes.excerpt: If you are talking about adding a stretch five rim protector, it looks to me like some other guys.
quotes.quote: If you are talking about adding a stretch five rim protector, it looks to me like some other guys might have to leave this roster to make that happen. Well, that also now chips away at a team that won 58 games but also lost in the first round.

quotes.speaker: Jim Owczarski
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo is not a center
quotes.excerpt: Giannis is not a center. Giannis hates playing center.
quotes.quote: Giannis is not a center. Giannis hates playing center. He will do it in spurts when it is a small ball lineup. Especially if you get to, let's take playoffs out of the equation because playoffs are a different animal. But like for 82 games of a regular season, no. Boston needs an actual center. An actual, look, Giannis is many years removed from his DPOY. He has not been an all-defensive player in many years. He still has an ability to turn it up when needed, that is where he is at defensively. So is Nemias Queta like playing 67 games and 34 minutes next to Giannis?
